findings.comment: Unit address schema table and addressing layout have not been submitted to City of Austin 911 Addressing Division for review and approval prior to site plan approval. No Address Unit Numbering Table (Excel) or Address Unit Numbering Plan (PDF) with Addressing Division approval documentation is present in the site plan submittal. Per grouping requirements, this review and approval must be completed before Commercial Plan Review or Residential Plan Review stage.

The Approved Addressed Floor Plan has not been attached to the site plan set as a separate PDF named 'Addressed Layout' or 'Approved Addressed Floor Plan,' and the approved unit schema table has not been included in the site plan set. Sheet 29 shows an addressing plan but lacks an approval stamp from the City of Austin 911 Addressing Division and no Excel table with the unit numbering schema is present.

Unit address schema table not submitted as an Excel spreadsheet with the required naming convention. No supplementary document named 'SP-2025-0126C Valley View Townhomes_Address Unit Numbering Table' or similar could be verified in the project records.

Addressing layout not submitted as a separate PDF with the required naming convention. While Sheet 29 serves as the addressing plan, it is not a separately named PDF document titled 'SP-2025-0126C Valley View Townhomes_Address Unit Numbering Plan' and lacks 911 Addressing Division approval documentation.

Cannot verify whether the addressing layout shows all required elements (door accesses, unique unit IDs, floor plan representations, building numbers) due to image resolution limitations of the available visual analysis. Sheet 29 shows building footprints and unit numbers but detailed verification of all door/garage/sidewalk accesses and complete labeling cannot be confirmed from available documentation.

Unit numbering schema cannot be verified as compliant with Addressing Standards Figure 2 (Building# + Floor# + Unit##). Current numbering shows Building# + Unit## (e.g., 101-104, 201-206) but lacks floor designators. For multi-building developments, Figure 2 requires floor numbers in the unit designation. Requires confirmation of which addressing schema applies and City of Austin 911 Addressing Division approval documentation.

Cannot verify whether attached townhome units with front door access directly to the street have been assigned separate independent main street addresses per Addressing Standards Figure 4. Current addressing shows units at a shared address (3759 Valley View Road, Unit 101-806) rather than individual main street addresses. Requires clarification from applicant and City of Austin 911 Addressing Division review confirming whether Figure 4 or Figure 2 schema applies and has been approved.

Cannot verify that the correct street address (as assigned by 911 Addressing Authority) appears on every sheet in the plan set without reviewing all 39 sheets individually. Cover sheet (Sheet 1) shows address as 3759 Valley View Road, Austin, TX 78704, but verification that this address appears on every sheet title block and client information block cannot be completed from available documentation.

For this multi-family project, a 911 address verification form must be submitted as part of the Austin Energy service design submittal package. Cannot verify whether this form has been included in the Austin Energy design submittal without access to the complete Austin Energy submission documentation.

Plans do not include a note stating that any changes to street names, building labels, unit configurations, unit arrangements, or access points after Addressing Division approval require a completely new addressing review prior to plan revision approval. This note is required on all sheets of multi-unit developments requiring Addressing Division approval.
